units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|A voice begins to speak from somewhere. "Your path brings you to a dead end, traveler. Nothing for you lies further."|22|0
units.english: A voice begins to speak from somewhere. "Your path brings you to a dead end, traveler. Nothing for you lies further."
units.italian: Una voce comincia a parlare da qualche parte. "La tua via ti conduce a un vicolo cieco, viaggiatore. Oltre non c'è nulla per te."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	Alarmed, you look around but nobody is there. You check your scanners but there is nothing present in this system except a few indigenous lifeforms. However, your navigation system displays hyperspace routes that lead beyond it.|23|0
units.english: Alarmed, you look around but nobody is there. You check your scanners but there is nothing present in this system except a few indigenous lifeforms. However, your navigation system displays hyperspace routes that lead beyond it.
units.italian: Allarmato, ti guardi attorno ma non c'è nessuno. Controlli gli scanner ma in questo sistema non c'è altro che qualche forma di vita indigena. Eppure il tuo sistema di navigazione mostra rotte iperspaziali che portano oltre.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	(Ignore it.)|25|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignorala.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"This doesn't appear to be a dead end."|26|0
units.english: "This doesn't appear to be a dead end."
units.italian: "Questo non sembra un vicolo cieco."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Why should I listen to you?"|28|0
units.english: "Why should I listen to you?"
units.italian: "E perché dovrei ascoltarti?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Ignoring these words is only but folly. Turn around, traveler." The voice echoes in the air, again with no indication of where it came from.|30|0
units.english: "Ignoring these words is only but folly. Turn around, traveler." The voice echoes in the air, again with no indication of where it came from.
units.italian: "Ignorare queste parole è pura follia. Torna indietro, viaggiatore." La voce riecheggia nell'aria, ancora senza indicare da dove venga.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"You can't fool me. This is no dead end."|32|0
units.english: "You can't fool me. This is no dead end."
units.italian: "Non puoi ingannarmi. Questo non è un vicolo cieco."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Why should I listen to you?"|33|0
units.english: "Why should I listen to you?"
units.italian: "E perché dovrei ascoltarti?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Here lie the unborn flowers yet to come into full bloom. There is nothing here for you to find. Heed this advice and turn back." The voice sounds more energetic this time, and you feel as if it is coming out of your head.|35|0
units.english: "Here lie the unborn flowers yet to come into full bloom. There is nothing here for you to find. Heed this advice and turn back." The voice sounds more energetic this time, and you feel as if it is coming out of your head.
units.italian: "Qui giacciono i fiori non ancora nati, che devono ancora schiudersi del tutto. Non c'è nulla qui che tu possa trovare. Ascolta questo avvertimento e torna indietro." La voce suona più energica questa volta, e ti sembra che venga da dentro la tua testa.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Unborn flowers. That sounds interesting."|37|0
units.english: "Unborn flowers. That sounds interesting."
units.italian: "Fiori non nati. Sembra interessante."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"I will see for myself."|38|0
units.english: "I will see for myself."
units.italian: "Lo vedrò di persona."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Thank you for the warning."|39|0
units.english: "Thank you for the warning."
units.italian: "Grazie dell'avvertimento."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	A deep sigh seems to drift through the continuum. "Human, these unborn flowers would only be endangered by your presence." An impression of euphoria comes over you as you once again hear the words 'unborn flowers.'|41|0
units.english: A deep sigh seems to drift through the continuum. "Human, these unborn flowers would only be endangered by your presence." An impression of euphoria comes over you as you once again hear the words 'unborn flowers.'
units.italian: Un sospiro profondo sembra scorrere nel continuum. "Umano, questi fiori non nati sarebbero solo messi in pericolo dalla tua presenza." Un'impressione di euforia ti pervade mentre senti di nuovo le parole 'fiori non nati'.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|"Please respect the beauty of life and do not step into this region that will soon bring forth another. Your kind is much more advanced than anything that you could hope to find here. No treasures here await you."|42|0
units.english: "Please respect the beauty of life and do not step into this region that will soon bring forth another. Your kind is much more advanced than anything that you could hope to find here. No treasures here await you."
units.italian: "Rispetta la bellezza della vita e non entrare in questa regione che presto ne darà un'altra. La tua specie è molto più avanzata di qualsiasi cosa tu possa sperare di trovare qui. Nessun tesoro ti attende qui."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Why do you care about these 'flowers'?"|44|0
units.english: "Why do you care about these 'flowers'?"
units.italian: "Perché ti importa di questi 'fiori'?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"What I search for is not technology."|46|0
units.english: "What I search for is not technology."
units.italian: "Ciò che cerco non è tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	The voice now takes on a calm tone. "Your persistence on this topic is admirable, but allow me to explain my conviction with an example."|47|0
units.english: The voice now takes on a calm tone. "Your persistence on this topic is admirable, but allow me to explain my conviction with an example."
units.italian: La voce assume ora un tono calmo. "La tua insistenza su questo punto è ammirevole, ma permettimi di spiegare la mia convinzione con un esempio."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|log|50|0
units.english: Entered a region of space northeast of the Hai and was warned by a disembodied voice to not disturb the "unborn flowers" that inhabit the region.
units.italian: Entrato in una regione di spazio a nord-est degli Hai e avvertito da una voce incorporea di non disturbare i "fiori non nati" che abitano la regione.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"Why do humans care about art?" The voice now seems far away yet more present than ever. "Because it amazes you, the same way it amazes us to see another kind grow and overcome their burdens. The lives of others are like a painting that never stops being painted, but is a tragic thing to watch the painting stop. That is why we try to protect these creations of life - so we can see what heights they reach."|52|0
units.english: "Why do humans care about art?" The voice now seems far away yet more present than ever. "Because it amazes you, the same way it amazes us to see another kind grow and overcome their burdens. The lives of others are like a painting that never stops being painted, but is a tragic thing to watch the painting stop. That is why we try to protect these creations of life - so we can see what heights they reach."
units.italian: "Perché agli umani importa dell'arte?" La voce ora sembra lontana ma più presente che mai. "Perché vi stupisce, come a noi stupisce vedere un'altra specie crescere e superare i propri fardelli. Le vite degli altri sono come un quadro che non smette mai di essere dipinto, ma è cosa tragica vedere il quadro fermarsi. Ecco perché cerchiamo di proteggere queste creazioni della vita: per vedere a quali altezze arrivano."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	There is a pause. "I see that you can not be convinced by me. Though I could intervene in your journey, I do not favor unsavory confrontation." The voice is now resolute in tone. "I will let you pass, but I will be watching you, as I am the guardian of this space."|53|0
units.english: There is a pause. "I see that you can not be convinced by me. Though I could intervene in your journey, I do not favor unsavory confrontation." The voice is now resolute in tone. "I will let you pass, but I will be watching you, as I am the guardian of this space."
units.italian: C'è una pausa. "Vedo che non posso convincerti. Potrei intervenire nel tuo viaggio, ma non amo gli scontri spiacevoli." La voce ora è risoluta. "Ti lascerò passare, ma ti osserverò, perché sono il guardiano di questo spazio."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	The voice fades out leaving nothing behind but the feeling of being watched.|54|0
units.english: The voice fades out leaving nothing behind but the feeling of being watched.
units.italian: La voce svanisce, non lasciando nulla dietro di sé se non la sensazione di essere osservato.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|log|58|0
units.english: Entered a region of space northeast of the Hai and was warned by a disembodied voice to not disturb the "unborn flowers" that inhabit the region. Agreed to stay away from there.
units.italian: Entrato in una regione di spazio a nord-est degli Hai e avvertito da una voce incorporea di non disturbare i "fiori non nati" che abitano la regione. Accettato di starne lontano.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Warning of the Guardian|	"You are understanding, human, so I thank you in the name of the Incipias." The voice fades away, leaving only the feeling of being watched."|61|0
units.english: "You are understanding, human, so I thank you in the name of the Incipias." The voice fades away, leaving only the feeling of being watched."
units.italian: "Sei comprensivo, umano, perciò ti ringrazio a nome degli Incipias." La voce svanisce, lasciando solo la sensazione di essere osservato."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Dom'us|The presence from the previous system somehow lingers as you continue to feel as though you're being watched.|75|0
units.context: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Dom'us
units.english: The presence from the previous system somehow lingers as you continue to feel as though you're being watched.
units.italian: La presenza del sistema precedente in qualche modo persiste, mentre continui a sentire di essere osservato.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Dom'us|As you enter the system, the same voice from before echoes through your mind, though this time there seems to be a heavy weight behind it. "I do not take kindly to your deception, human. Know that you will be watched." The voice fades away, but the strong presence of something remains.|79|0
units.context: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Dom'us
units.english: As you enter the system, the same voice from before echoes through your mind, though this time there seems to be a heavy weight behind it. "I do not take kindly to your deception, human. Know that you will be watched." The voice fades away, but the strong presence of something remains.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, la stessa voce di prima riecheggia nella tua mente, anche se questa volta sembra avere un peso grave dietro. "Non apprezzo il tuo inganno, umano. Sappi che sarai osservato." La voce svanisce, ma resta la forte presenza di qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Hui'uc|The presence from the previous system somehow lingers as you continue to feel as though you're being watched.|95|0
units.context: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Hui'uc
units.english: The presence from the previous system somehow lingers as you continue to feel as though you're being watched.
units.italian: La presenza del sistema precedente in qualche modo persiste, mentre continui a sentire di essere osservato.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Hui'uc|As you enter the system, the same voice from before echoes through your mind, though this time there seems to be a heavy weight behind it. "I do not take kindly to your deception, human. Know that you will be watched." The voice fades away, but the strong presence of something remains.|99|0
units.context: mission:Incipias: Presence of the Guardian: Hui'uc
units.english: As you enter the system, the same voice from before echoes through your mind, though this time there seems to be a heavy weight behind it. "I do not take kindly to your deception, human. Know that you will be watched." The voice fades away, but the strong presence of something remains.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, la stessa voce di prima riecheggia nella tua mente, anche se questa volta sembra avere un peso grave dietro. "Non apprezzo il tuo inganno, umano. Sappi che sarai osservato." La voce svanisce, ma resta la forte presenza di qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Incipias: First Contact|As you enter the system, you notice ships of a type you have never seen before. Hailing them only gives you static. After some more unsuccessful attempts, you give up. Maybe you can find some more information in nearby systems.|117|0
units.english: As you enter the system, you notice ships of a type you have never seen before. Hailing them only gives you static. After some more unsuccessful attempts, you give up. Maybe you can find some more information in nearby systems.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, noti navi di un tipo che non hai mai visto. Chiamarle dà solo fruscio. Dopo altri tentativi senza successo, rinunci. Forse puoi trovare altre informazioni nei sistemi vicini.

units.id: mission:Incipias: First Contact|As you enter the system, you notice ships of a type you have never seen before. Hailing them only gives you static. After some more unsuccessful attempts, you give up. This must be the species the Quarg talked about.|121|0
units.english: As you enter the system, you notice ships of a type you have never seen before. Hailing them only gives you static. After some more unsuccessful attempts, you give up. This must be the species the Quarg talked about.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, noti navi di un tipo che non hai mai visto. Chiamarle dà solo fruscio. Dopo altri tentativi senza successo, rinunci. Dev'essere la specie di cui parlavano i Quarg.

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|label|137|0
units.english: ut divitas
units.italian: ut divitas

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|Your spaceship lands with a soft jolt as a small group of Quarg quickly gathers around it, making some simple but clear gestures telling you to wait. After they've realized that you understood, one of them walks away in a hurried manner. You wait for quite some time until a different Quarg arrives, presumably one that can speak your language. It begins to speak in an accent you can't place.|138|0
units.english: Your spaceship lands with a soft jolt as a small group of Quarg quickly gathers around it, making some simple but clear gestures telling you to wait. After they've realized that you understood, one of them walks away in a hurried manner. You wait for quite some time until a different Quarg arrives, presumably one that can speak your language. It begins to speak in an accent you can't place.
units.italian: La tua nave atterra con un piccolo sobbalzo mentre un gruppetto di Quarg si raduna rapidamente attorno, facendo gesti semplici ma chiari per dirti di aspettare. Dopo essersi resi conto che hai capito, uno di loro si allontana in fretta. Aspetti parecchio tempo finché non arriva un altro Quarg, presumibilmente uno che parla la tua lingua. Comincia a parlare con un accento che non riesci a collocare.

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|label|140|0
units.english: spec inci
units.italian: spec inci

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	After landing your ship on the moon, you have to wait for a decent amount of time for a group of three Quarg to appear. The one in the middle gestures you to approach them, and they begin to speak in an accent you can't place.|141|0
units.english: After landing your ship on the moon, you have to wait for a decent amount of time for a group of three Quarg to appear. The one in the middle gestures you to approach them, and they begin to speak in an accent you can't place.
units.italian: Dopo aver fatto atterrare la nave sulla luna, devi aspettare un bel po' perché compaia un gruppo di tre Quarg. Quello al centro ti fa cenno di avvicinarti, e cominciano a parlare con un accento che non riesci a collocare.

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|label|142|0
units.english: both planets
units.italian: both planets

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	"Welcome, human. Your lengthy wanderings have brought forth you here, yet your kind has never set foot in this region of the stars. May we inquire as to your mission?"|143|0
units.english: "Welcome, human. Your lengthy wanderings have brought forth you here, yet your kind has never set foot in this region of the stars. May we inquire as to your mission?"
units.italian: "Benvenuto, umano. I tuoi lunghi vagabondaggi ti hanno condotto fin qui, eppure la tua specie non ha mai messo piede in questa regione delle stelle. Possiamo chiederti quale sia la tua missione?"

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	"I am just exploring the galaxy."|145|0
units.english: "I am just exploring the galaxy."
units.italian: "Sto solo esplorando la galassia."

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	"I am looking for new species."|147|0
units.english: "I am looking for new species."
units.italian: "Cerco nuove specie."

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	"It is an obvious pursuit for the young," it nods. "If I may advise you, do not perambulate across this quarter of space in a careless manner. The galaxy carries many perilous situations that your kind has yet to uncover or even to comprehend." It straightens up to its full height, towering over you.|150|0
units.english: "It is an obvious pursuit for the young," it nods. "If I may advise you, do not perambulate across this quarter of space in a careless manner. The galaxy carries many perilous situations that your kind has yet to uncover or even to comprehend." It straightens up to its full height, towering over you.
units.italian: "È una ricerca ovvia per i giovani", annuisce. "Se posso consigliarti, non peregrinare per questo quarto di spazio con leggerezza. La galassia porta con sé molte situazioni pericolose che la tua specie deve ancora scoprire o persino comprendere." Si raddrizza in tutta la sua altezza, torreggiando su di te.

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|label|152|0
units.english: new species
units.italian: new species

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	"What a peculiar task that is." It looks confused and tilts its head. "What do you hope to achieve by this? That an unfathomable amount of dangers come with encountering and treating with other species, did you not foresee? The boundaries of space are not idle accidents. I advise you to be scrupulous and ponder every last step."|153|0
units.english: "What a peculiar task that is." It looks confused and tilts its head. "What do you hope to achieve by this? That an unfathomable amount of dangers come with encountering and treating with other species, did you not foresee? The boundaries of space are not idle accidents. I advise you to be scrupulous and ponder every last step."
units.italian: "Che compito singolare." Sembra confuso e inclina la testa. "Che cosa speri di ottenere? Una quantità incommensurabile di pericoli accompagna l'incontro e il trattare con altre specie: non lo avevi previsto? I confini dello spazio non sono oziosi incidenti. Ti consiglio di essere scrupoloso e di ponderare ogni singolo passo."

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	After a short pause, you notice an almost-hidden frustration lurking beneath the Quarg's face before it continues speaking. "You are authorized to continue your nomadic voyagings here, but there are demands we Quarg make of you. Within a trifling interval of this moon the neighboring kind has initiated their journey to the stars. Do not interrupt them for yours, or sake of their own."|155|0
units.english: After a short pause, you notice an almost-hidden frustration lurking beneath the Quarg's face before it continues speaking. "You are authorized to continue your nomadic voyagings here, but there are demands we Quarg make of you. Within a trifling interval of this moon the neighboring kind has initiated their journey to the stars. Do not interrupt them for yours, or sake of their own."
units.italian: Dopo una breve pausa, noti una frustrazione quasi nascosta in fondo al volto del Quarg, prima che riprenda a parlare. "Sei autorizzato a continuare qui i tuoi vagabondaggi nomadi, ma noi Quarg abbiamo delle richieste. A un intervallo minimo da questa luna la specie vicina ha iniziato il suo viaggio verso le stelle. Non interromperlo per il tuo, o per il loro bene."

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Incipias Space|	With these words the Quarg turn around and leave. It seems like you are free to use the local facilities now.|156|0
units.english: With these words the Quarg turn around and leave. It seems like you are free to use the local facilities now.
units.italian: Con queste parole i Quarg si voltano e se ne vanno. Sembra che ora tu sia libero di usare le strutture locali.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|Upon entering the system, you notice a lone alien spaceship that is disabled and badly damaged. Aside from it, there do not appear to be any other ships in the system, or sign of any help for that matter. Maybe there's some way you could assist the ship and its crew.|181|0
units.english: Upon entering the system, you notice a lone alien spaceship that is disabled and badly damaged. Aside from it, there do not appear to be any other ships in the system, or sign of any help for that matter. Maybe there's some way you could assist the ship and its crew.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, noti una nave spaziale aliena solitaria, fuori uso e gravemente danneggiata. A parte lei, non sembra esserci nessun'altra nave nel sistema, né segno di aiuti. Forse c'è un modo per assistere la nave e il suo equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|log|197|0
units.english: Assisted a stranded alien vessel in an uninhabited system whose crew members appeared similar to floating octopi or jellyfish. Could not communicate with them due to the language barrier, but managed to give them the equipment they needed to repair their ship. Unfortunately, they lacked a hyperdrive and so were unable to travel back to their home system.
units.italian: Aiutata una nave aliena bloccata in un sistema disabitato, il cui equipaggio assomigliava a polpi o meduse fluttuanti. Impossibile comunicare per la barriera linguistica, ma si è riusciti a dare loro l'equipaggiamento necessario a riparare la nave. Purtroppo erano privi di iperguida e quindi incapaci di tornare al loro sistema d'origine.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|As you approach the derelict ship, it sends you a hail request. Once you accept the hail, color gradients suddenly start moving over your screen in a dizzying fashion, but curiously there is no audio. It's clear that unless you have some sort of translation device, you will not be able to understand whatever transmission you just witnessed. You continue your attempt to assist the ship, preparing to bring some repair supplies on board.|200|0
units.english: As you approach the derelict ship, it sends you a hail request. Once you accept the hail, color gradients suddenly start moving over your screen in a dizzying fashion, but curiously there is no audio. It's clear that unless you have some sort of translation device, you will not be able to understand whatever transmission you just witnessed. You continue your attempt to assist the ship, preparing to bring some repair supplies on board.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini alla nave relitto, ti invia una richiesta di collegamento. Una volta accettata, gradienti di colore iniziano improvvisamente a muoversi sul tuo schermo in modo vertiginoso, ma curiosamente non c'è audio. È chiaro che, senza una sorta di dispositivo di traduzione, non potrai capire qualunque trasmissione tu abbia appena visto. Continui il tuo tentativo di assistere la nave, preparandoti a portare a bordo alcune provviste di riparazione.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	You manage to dock to the disabled ship quite easily. The hatch opens and as a hallway opens up before you, it is immediately obvious that this ship was not designed for humans. The walls are strangely curved, and the floor has nearly no grip at all. As you carry the repair equipment into the ship, your view is caught by five giant aliens - half octopod, half jellyfish in appearance. They pulsate in bright colors similar to the gradients that appeared on your screen earlier. One of them is floating behind what's clearly a giant mounted weapon, and the two barrels are pointed right at you. The alien gunner flashes in an orange light, and you can feel the tension in the room rising.|201|0
units.english: You manage to dock to the disabled ship quite easily. The hatch opens and as a hallway opens up before you, it is immediately obvious that this ship was not designed for humans. The walls are strangely curved, and the floor has nearly no grip at all. As you carry the repair equipment into the ship, your view is caught by five giant aliens - half octopod, half jellyfish in appearance. They pulsate in bright colors similar to the gradients that appeared on your screen earlier. One of them is floating behind what's clearly a giant mounted weapon, and the two barrels are pointed right at you. The alien gunner flashes in an orange light, and you can feel the tension in the room rising.
units.italian: Riesci ad attraccare alla nave fuori uso con una certa facilità. Il portello si apre e, mentre davanti a te si apre un corridoio, è subito evidente che questa nave non è stata progettata per gli umani. Le pareti sono stranamente curve, e il pavimento non offre quasi alcun appiglio. Mentre porti l'attrezzatura di riparazione dentro la nave, il tuo sguardo è catturato da cinque alieni giganteschi, in parte polpi e in parte meduse. Pulsano di colori vivaci, simili ai gradienti apparsi prima sul tuo schermo. Uno di loro fluttua dietro quello che è chiaramente un'enorme arma montata, e le due canne sono puntate dritte su di te. L'artigliere alieno lampeggia di luce arancione, e senti la tensione nella stanza salire.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	(Try to convey that I intend no harm.)|203|0
units.english: (Try to convey that I intend no harm.)
units.italian: (Cerca di comunicare che non ho cattive intenzioni.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	(Drop the repair equipment and run back into my ship.)|205|0
units.english: (Drop the repair equipment and run back into my ship.)
units.italian: (Lascia cadere l'attrezzatura di riparazione e corri di nuovo sulla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	(Try to shoot at the one behind the turret and run.)|207|0
units.english: (Try to shoot at the one behind the turret and run.)
units.italian: (Prova a sparare a quello dietro la torretta e corri.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	You hit the creature manning the turret, causing it to explode with a strident sound. Before you can enjoy your short-lived victory, you notice a motion further down the hallway. Turning your head you see a gunner flashing in a deep red, before shooting you down and avenging their fallen comrade.|208|0
units.english: You hit the creature manning the turret, causing it to explode with a strident sound. Before you can enjoy your short-lived victory, you notice a motion further down the hallway. Turning your head you see a gunner flashing in a deep red, before shooting you down and avenging their fallen comrade.
units.italian: Colpisci la creatura che manovra la torretta, facendola esplodere con un suono stridente. Prima che tu possa goderti la tua breve vittoria, noti un movimento più in fondo al corridoio. Voltando la testa vedi un artigliere che lampeggia di rosso cupo, prima che ti abbatta vendicando il compagno caduto.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	Feeling that the situation could escalate any moment, you slowly place the crate with the repair equipment on the ground and walk back a few steps. You are careful not to make any hasty movements. Both you and the aliens are still for a moment until one of them slowly floats forward. Tones of yellow are now mixing into the creature's orange color, and two of their tentacles wrap around the crate while the other four back off in response. Once the alien manages to open the crate and look inside, its colors shift to a weak green. The rest of the crew also seem to relax as they take on the same color.|211|0
units.english: Feeling that the situation could escalate any moment, you slowly place the crate with the repair equipment on the ground and walk back a few steps. You are careful not to make any hasty movements. Both you and the aliens are still for a moment until one of them slowly floats forward. Tones of yellow are now mixing into the creature's orange color, and two of their tentacles wrap around the crate while the other four back off in response. Once the alien manages to open the crate and look inside, its colors shift to a weak green. The rest of the crew also seem to relax as they take on the same color.
units.italian: Sentendo che la situazione potrebbe degenerare da un momento all'altro, appoggi lentamente la cassa con l'attrezzatura di riparazione a terra e fai qualche passo indietro. Stai attento a non fare movimenti bruschi. Tu e gli alieni restate immobili per un momento, finché uno di loro fluttua lentamente in avanti. Tonalità di giallo si mescolano ora all'arancione della creatura, e due dei loro tentacoli si avvolgono attorno alla cassa mentre gli altri quattro si ritirano. Quando l'alieno riesce ad aprire la cassa e a guardare dentro, i suoi colori passano a un verde debole. Anche il resto dell'equipaggio sembra rilassarsi, assumendo lo stesso colore.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	With the aliens retrieving the repair equipment, there is nothing else you can do, given the communication barrier. Just as you leave, you can see how the aliens start pulsating in all colors of the spectrum; gradients are moving over their skin so fast that they almost look white.|212|0
units.english: With the aliens retrieving the repair equipment, there is nothing else you can do, given the communication barrier. Just as you leave, you can see how the aliens start pulsating in all colors of the spectrum; gradients are moving over their skin so fast that they almost look white.
units.italian: Con gli alieni che recuperano l'attrezzatura di riparazione, non c'è altro che tu possa fare, data la barriera linguistica. Proprio mentre te ne vai, vedi gli alieni iniziare a pulsare di tutti i colori dello spettro; i gradienti scorrono sulla loro pelle così veloci che sembrano quasi bianchi.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	You drop the repair equipment and run back into your ship, smashing the button that closes the lock. You get a last look of one of the aliens: blue and yellow tones are mixing on their skin, but they are not taking any action.|215|0
units.english: You drop the repair equipment and run back into your ship, smashing the button that closes the lock. You get a last look of one of the aliens: blue and yellow tones are mixing on their skin, but they are not taking any action.
units.italian: Lasci cadere l'attrezzatura di riparazione e corri di nuovo sulla tua nave, premendo con forza il pulsante che chiude il portello. Hai un ultimo sguardo a uno degli alieni: tonalità blu e gialle si mescolano sulla sua pelle, ma non reagiscono.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	As you fly away you see the engines of the ship slowly booting back up. Apparently they figured out how to use the repair equipment. Instead of leaving the system, however, the ship begins to fly towards a nearby gas giant.|217|0
units.english: As you fly away you see the engines of the ship slowly booting back up. Apparently they figured out how to use the repair equipment. Instead of leaving the system, however, the ship begins to fly towards a nearby gas giant.
units.italian: Mentre voli via vedi i motori della nave riaccendersi lentamente. A quanto pare hanno capito come usare l'attrezzatura di riparazione. Invece di lasciare il sistema, però, la nave comincia a volare verso un gigante gassoso vicino.

units.id: mission:Incipias: The Derelict|	Back on your ship, your eyes fall on the scanner log that is still open on your monitor. Notably, this ship had no hyperdrive or anything similar installed, which is strange considering there is no inhabited planet in this system. Maybe you should talk to the Quarg and see if they have any insight on this.|218|0
units.english: Back on your ship, your eyes fall on the scanner log that is still open on your monitor. Notably, this ship had no hyperdrive or anything similar installed, which is strange considering there is no inhabited planet in this system. Maybe you should talk to the Quarg and see if they have any insight on this.
units.italian: Di nuovo sulla tua nave, i tuoi occhi cadono sul registro degli scanner ancora aperto sul monitor. Da notare che questa nave non aveva iperguida né nulla di simile installato, il che è strano considerando che in questo sistema non c'è alcun pianeta abitato. Forse dovresti parlare con i Quarg e vedere se sanno qualcosa.
